lines.speaker: Zi
lines.text: There's a snare line here. Recent.
lines.lens: Braided cord, Ereivyn weave. Tension set for something larger than us. This was laid with purpose.

lines.speaker: Rynn
lines.text: Don't touch the third stake. It's load-bearing.

lines.speaker: Zi
lines.monologue: Voice from above. She's in the canopy. Smart. You set traps where you can watch them.

lines.speaker: Rynn
lines.text: You military? You walk like military. Valdrihn, probably. The posture gives it away.

lines.speaker: Rynn
lines.text: Former military is still military. Just with more opinions.
lines.monologue: She drops from the branches. Shorter than expected. Practical clothes, heavy pack. Every pocket has something in it.

lines.speaker: Rynn
lines.text: Rynn. Trader. These are my traps and you're in my corridor, so I'd appreciate not scattering my morning's work.

lines.speaker: Zi
lines.text: Zi. This is Caelan and Suri. We're passing through.

lines.speaker: Rynn
lines.text: Nobody passes through Ereivyn. You're either going somewhere specific or you're lost. Which is it?

lines.speaker: Zi
lines.text: Somewhere specific. We're not sure where yet.
lines.monologue: Honest answer. She'll respect it or she won't.

lines.speaker: Rynn
lines.text: That's the most honest stupid thing anyone's said to me this season. I like it.

lines.speaker: Rynn
lines.text: I need to get stock to the Velundrath coast. Route's been bad — things in the deep forest got restless. You look like you can handle restless things.

lines.speaker: Suri
lines.text: She's proposing a trade. Protection for knowledge of the route.

lines.speaker: Rynn
lines.monologue: She's already repacking her traps. Decision made before she finished the sentence. Logistics mind — she planned this conversation three moves ago.

choices.text: Deal. We could use someone who knows the ground.
Protection's expensive. What else are you offering?

lines.speaker: Zi
lines.text: Deal. We could use someone who knows the ground.
lines.monologue: Clean trade. No hidden costs. I respect that more than I should admit.

lines.speaker: Rynn
lines.text: Good. I've got three days of dried provisions and a map with the bad stretches marked. You won't regret this.
lines.monologue: She said it like a weather report. Factual. The kind of confidence that comes from always being prepared.

lines.speaker: Zi
lines.monologue: She was already walking. I matched her pace without thinking about it. Some people you fall in step with before you decide to.

lines.speaker: Zi
lines.text: Protection's expensive. What else are you offering?
lines.monologue: Not greed. Due diligence. Three more people to keep fed means the math has to work.

lines.speaker: Rynn
lines.text: Fair. I know the water sources for the next sixty kilometers. I know which game trails are still safe and which ones the restless things have claimed. And I carry my own weight — always have.
lines.monologue: She listed it like inventory. No salesmanship. Just the contents of what she was worth.

lines.speaker: Suri
lines.text: Take the deal, Zi. She's undervaluing herself and she knows it.
lines.monologue: Suri smiled at Rynn. One merchant recognizing another.

lines.speaker: Zi
lines.monologue: Suri was right. She was worth more than she was asking. People like that are rare enough to keep close.
